title: Cannabis Recipes: Infused Food and Drinks
metaDescription: Cannabis recipes for adults 21+: infused butter and oil, baked goods, savory dishes and drinks, each with a dosing note for cooking responsibly at home.

hero.lead: Cooking with cannabis starts with two building blocks: decarboxylated flower and an infused butter or oil. Our cannabis recipes cover both, then put them to work in baked goods, savory dishes, sauces and infused drinks, each with a dosing note. Homemade edibles are hard to dose evenly, so start with a small serving, wait before having more, label everything clearly and store it away from children and pets. For adults 21 and older.
